notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven creature cards in your graveyard.
description:
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Deathbloom Ritualist.
Activate Mimeoplasm by tapping it, adding at least seven {G/U}.
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Gilder Bairn.
Activate Mimeoplasm using Gilder Bairn's ability by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it.
Repeat.
